title: Semiclassical Analysis of Tunneling in Graphene under Nonuniform Electrostatic and Magnetic Fields
summary: We develop a semiclassical theory of tunnelling of Dirac fermions through an n-p-n junction in monolayer graphene subjected to a perpendicular magnetic field. Electrostatic and magnetic fields are assumed to be smooth functions of a single spatial coordinate, supported on a finite interval, vanishing outside it, and thus ensuring asymptotically free states.
